name: Cascante del Río (Spain)
description: Blue field with a yellow tree at the upper hoist, divided by a light blue stepped line from the lower hoist to the upper fly from a fly part of red and yellow bars.
history: Municipal flag of Cascante del Río; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: stepped line from the lower hoist to the upper fly
bars of yellow and red at the lower fly
